 SUBJECT: PAYMENT OF BID MONEY BY AND TRANSFER OF LAND TO ZAMEEN CBD REIT 
 Dear Sir, 
 We are writing regarding the Letter of Acceptance, bearing reference No. PCBDDA/COMMS/024/0534, dated 05-06-2024 (“ LOA ”). The LOA was issued by your esteemed office in favo u r of Zameen Development Private Limited (“ ZD ”) to convey the acceptance of the bid for Plot No. 2-B-30, spanning 8.89 kanals, located at CBD Business Bay 2, Lahore (“ Project Land ”). 
 
 At the outset, we would like to bring to your attention that ZD participated in the bid and paid the earnest money amounting to PKR 20,000,000 ( Pak Rupees Twenty Million Only ). This bid and earnest money were submitted by ZD on behalf of an arrangement with Zameen REIT Management Company (“ ZRMC ”) to streamline the financial processes and ensure a smooth transition of the Project Land to a newly established REIT Scheme. 
 
 We would like to inform you that the REIT Scheme has now been established in the name of “Zameen CBD REIT” as of 11 th July 2024 under the REIT Regulations 2022 and registered under Section 15-A of the Punjab Trust s Act 2020 , as amended . 
 
 In light of the above, ZRMC on behalf of the Zameen CBD REIT will assume the responsibility for payment obligations and duties under the LOA from the date of this letter. Accordingly, we request that the Project Land be allocated, booked, and later allotted under the name Zameen CBD REIT as all current and future payments s hall be made through the bank account of Zameen CBD REIT. Consequently, f rom this point onwards, ZD will not be associated with the P roject L and or liable for any obligations under the LOA. We would appreciate it if you could acknowledge this change and issue a revised LOA (if necessary) , crediting the payments made to date in favour of Zameen CBD REIT against the Project Land . 
 
 We request all correspondence regarding the Project Land should now be directed to ZRMC, the Management Company of the Zameen CBD REIT. 
 
 Currently, we are making a payment of PKR 195,138,000 (Pakistani Rupees One Hundred Ninety-Five Million One Hundred Thirty-Eight Thousand Only) through Call Deposit Slip No. 00472920 dated 18 th July 2024. This is in addition to the PKR 20,000,000 (Pakistani Rupees Twenty Million Only) previously paid as earnest money by ZD, which we request it may be adjusted to the total amount of PKR 215,138,000 (Pakistani Rupees Two Hundred Fifteen Million One Hundred Thirty-Eight Thousand Only) (“ Earnest Money ”) as per Clause 35 of the Information Memorandum for the auction dated 23 rd May 2024 . The Earnest Money, along with the payment made with this letter, amounts to ten percent (10%) of the total value of PKR 2,151,380,000 (Pakistani Rupees Two Billion One Hundred Fifty-One Million Three Hundred Eighty Thousand Only) of the Project Land as per the LOA. As the payment is being made by Zameen CBD REIT, we once again request that the Project Land be transferred in the name of Zameen CBD REIT since they are assuming all obligations under the LOA. 
 
 We appreciate your understanding and attention to this matter and are grateful for our continued partnership regarding the Project Land. Should you require any further information, please do not hesitate to contact us. 
 
 Yours sincerely, 
 For and on behalf of Zameen REIT Management Company
